system.description:
Instead of temporarily transforming your limbs when striking, you transfigure them temporarily maintaining their form. Select which ligaments you want to transform, between your arms or legs. Casting this jutsu while currently benefiting from it dispels any previous instance of it.

Monstrous Arms: Your arms grow in size, and transforms into a monstrous form resembling arms with jet like ports protruding from your elbow. While in this form, your Unarmed damage die is increased by + 1d8 force damage.

Jet Legs: Your legs grow in size and transforms into a monstrous form resembling legs with jet like ports on your ankles. While in this form, your speed is increased by +15, your jump height is increased by +20 feet, and creatures make attacks of opportunities against you at disadvantage.

Amplify: By spending 3 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, if you select Monstrous Arms, your Unarmed attacks gain the Deadly 2 quality. If you select Jet Legs, when you cast a Taijutsu, increase its range by +10 feet as you can perform short burst movements before applying its effects.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, when you cast this jutsu, you can gain the benefit of both forms.
